headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2021: Kyle O'Reilly went straight to headlining on debut, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.22 ? a strong outing. Reunited with former Undisputed Era stablemates, O'Reilly's in-ring AEW debut saw the trio brawl their way through a chaotic tag match ? a superkick miscue on Cassidy inadvertently took out Adam Cole, but O'Reilly and Fish still found a way to steal the win.
It was 2023 when Beretta, Cassidy & Romero made a statement, debuting in the main event as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.76.
Turning the clock back to 2021: it was the first-ever encounter between Private Party & Hardy and Jurassic Express & Cage, kicking off the show on Dynamite, rated 6.47.

secondaries.text: It was 2021 when Proud-N-Powerful & Kingston touched down in AEW for the first time as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.38.
Looking back to 2023, when Wheeler Yuta vs. Matt Sydal clashed for the ROH Pure Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.30.
That Wednesday in 2021, Jade Cargill vs. Thunder Rosa met for the very first time on Dynamite, rated 4.31.
